verdict.rationale: Brevo documents segment building from demographics, website activity, campaign engagement, and custom events, with unlimited segments, plus behavioral event tracking and contact scores usable for segmentation. It does not document tag-based filters or that segments update dynamically as data changes. Community items are off-topic. Missing for 10: tag-based segment criteria, evidence that segments stay live/dynamic as data changes, in-depth segmentation docs, independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a marketer, I can build audience segments from profile attributes, tags, and behavioral events, and they stay live as data changes

citations.quote: Search, save, and manage contacts with filters like demographics, website activity, campaign engagement, and custom events. Create as many segments as you need.
Track custom user events and behaviors.
Get contact scores based on engagement, purchases, and behaviors to trigger automations or create targeted segments.
